lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The 390 by 844 production path now keeps slow analysis, safe cancellation, no-persistence truth, and retry visible without scrolling; cancellation preserves the selected source, crop, and masks. VoiceOver, alternative input, real-device background, relaunch, and accessibility-size behavior remain untested.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-10-workspace-screenshot-cancellation-runtime-proof.json; output/playwright/workspace-screenshot-analysis-slow-mobile-final.png sha256:976b5c53715f1d2e1753f10593cd0c7cf0b503ed22f288ab18510218af773c03; dimension trace task_legibility=3, information_hierarchy=3, evidence_control=3, platform_interaction=3, accessibility=2, state_completeness=3, feedback_recovery=3, visual_craft=3, performance_feel=3.
findings.user_impact: A mobile recruiter can understand and stop a slow request without losing local preparation or creating hidden state, while release-level assistive and app-lifecycle behavior cannot yet be claimed.
findings.recommendation: Run the complete capture-to-People path with VoiceOver, Full Keyboard Access, accessibility text sizes, background, relaunch, and small and large real devices.
findings.verification: Identity, source, uncertainty, slow state, cancel, retry, evidence decision, Wiki result, and No action remain ordered, named, unclipped, recoverable, and duplicate-free in every tested mode.

strengths: The slow-state message is now a persistent semantic status below the modal title instead of content that can fall below the mobile viewport.
Cancel analysis remains visible in the fixed footer and accurately returns to a retryable local state.
The 390-pixel cancellation trace preserved 20 people and 30 captures and produced zero console errors.
The responsive design still uses textual state labels and never ranks candidate worth.
missing_evidence: VoiceOver, Switch Control, increased contrast, accessibility-size, and assistive-technology user evidence.
Real-device background, relaunch, virtual keyboard, landscape, and oldest-supported-browser runs.
Measured provider latency budgets outside the controlled slow-response simulation.
open_questions: After what measured latency should the product offer a durable leave-and-resume draft rather than only in-place cancellation?
